title: Home
text:
Welcome to the NYC Department of Finance Property Modeling Site
This is as a central reference for staff working on property valuation, modeling, and analysis. It brings together key components of our ongoing modeling efforts, including:

Assessor Districts: Interactive tools and resources to understand jurisdictions for assessors by district, block and section volume.
Data Dictionary: A shared reference for data sources and variable definitions across our data resources.

If you have any questions on the content displayed on this site, feel free to reach out to boydclaire@finance.nyc.gov or open an GitHub issue explaining the request.

title: Data Dictionary
text:
Explore the following pages that help document the data resources available to DOF’s property modeling team:

All Tables: This is a comprehensive list of all database tables within Production, FDW, and IAS databases, including the prefix used, number of columns in the table, and primary keys where relevant (unit of observation: table).
Building Classifications: A table that contains all building classifications with their tax class, description, use and relevant model codes.
FDW to Vision Crosswalk: A table that contains FDW table names and their matching CAMA table names if applicable, as well as the prefix used and relevant primary keys for the table (unit of observation: table).
Model Codes: A table that maps the Vision model codes to the specific property types.
REAL_PROP Column Lookup: A table that contains all columns for the most important REAL_PROP tables in the production database, including the column type, description, and if it is a primary key (unit of observation: column).
PDM/PTS Column Lookup: A table that contains information for columns for PDM tables (notably: NEWBASE, CONDBASE) and PTS tables (notably: ASMT, PARDAT, and APRVAL) available in the FDW database (FDW3NF), including the column type, description, and additional notes if relevant (unit of observation: column).

To download any of these data sets, visit the source data here.
